cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your wedding dress reached our depot this morning. Leave the collection to me; we'll get this sorted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Which depot? I can drive there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of ours. Collection is arranged, not improvised. Stay here; I'll look after you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I ring and arrange it myself?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's not confuse matters by adding another voice, love. You're in good hands right here.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 independent call to narrow access to A alone, without giving even the vague depot detail from A3.
